text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You want to know more about Air Shakur?
But then why are you
asking me?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Surely you've heard about my session with
her... She and I couldn't
see eye to eye.
Heck, we barely spoke. I won't be much
help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our last encounter, it doesn't seem
wise to ask Air Shakur about herself
directly. So instead,
I decide to ask others about their
impressions of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to know more about her—her
achievements, her path up until now...
everything. The more I learn about her,
the more I'll
understand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you there. I emailed you just now, so
be sure to check your inbox.
Bye now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my inbox, I find Agnes Tachyon's
email... and the files attached to
it. Every
single one looks like a complex research
paper...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All of those were received from Shakur as
part of a trade between researchers. Her
graphs and formula layouts should reveal
something
about her inner workings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As should her blunt writing devoid of any
flowery modifiers. While I
personally see
commitment to aesthetics in her work...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
According to her, she's doing no such
thing. I'm not sure I believe
that... Ah, I
suppose those papers may be a tad
difficult to comprehend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Well, I won't explain them either, so do your best. As long as you do that, something is bound to happen. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Helping" you certainly was not my
intention. But as a researcher... I
do not
want anything to impede progress. Yours
or hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So begins my days of collecting
information on Air Shakur. I watch 
countless recordings and inquire with
other trainers and her
classmates alike. Until...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I better find a trainer soon. Why did a
trainer have to be one of the
conditions to
debut... Guess it's a bit late to object.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A trainer, huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You still want to win though, right?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You still want to win though, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No matter who I pick, they're going to be
a pain. In that case,
anyone's fine... Not
like they'll do much anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(That said... The thought of seeing their
confused face every day makes my skin
crawl. And what's the point of debuting...
if I already
know what will happen?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should just give up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Not like it would be that weird to say. Maybe now's just the time to quit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, who the hell wants to play a game
they already know the
ending to? Morons,
that's who.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. So—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After retracing her steps through reports
and recordings, I've come to know a
fraction of the effort she's put into
winning the Derby. So I
know for a fact...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I hate when people talk to me like
that.
You don't know me, so quit
acting like it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I try, I may never
catch even a glimpse of her
world... but
that won't stop me from trying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she'll let me, I'm sure we can work
together to achieve her goal. Even if we
aren't alike,
our eyes can still settle on the
same horizon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How the... You can't even write code. And
you base your actions on
ambiguous things
like dreams. We're nothing alike.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You really think... you can understand me? How could you? And even if you could... What good would it do?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And what if... it all amounts to nothing?
Are you really—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I seriously don't get you. Training me
wouldn't benefit you in any
way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? How?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to see the moment her hard work—her obsession pays off. As a trainer, there could be no greater reward than that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you don't understand a word I'm
saying... Not really seeing
the benefit for
me either at this point.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I won't need to debut if I quit, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell was up with that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"But I don't want to give up on trying to
understand you either."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"But I don't want to give up on trying to
understand you either."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Shut up. Piss off. Even if you could get
me... what good would your
stubborn ass
do anyways?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Although... I suppose persistence is the
one thing we have in
common.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've yet to find a way to breach those
seven centimeters. Nothing's
changed
since I first calculated my chances.
But...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Giving up... just doesn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night,
I spot Air Shakur as I'm out and
about. Worried, I decide to watch over her
from a distance until she returns to the
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, you've been following that girl
for a while now. Care to
tell me why?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
We've received reports of someone
stalking Umamusume at night.
Perhaps you
could tell me what you know about that at
the station?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh... Guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, leave 'em alone. Can't you see
they're scared? Besides...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That "stalker" is my trainer... Isn't that
right?
